11101.name: Attaque Composee

attributes.name: Attaque Composee: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Attaque Composee] by 1% per attribute level.

11102.name: Lunge

attributes.name: Lunge: Enhance

attributes.name: Sept Etoiles: Enhance

11104.name: Attaque Coquille

attributes.name: Attaque Coquille: Enhance

11105.name: Esquive Toucher
11105.description: [Physical] - [Pierce]Move swiftly to avoid enemy attacks and deliver complex successive attacks.

11107.name: Flanconnade

attributes.name: Flanconnade: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Flanconnade] by 1% per attribute level.

11201.name: Mijin no Jutsu
11201.description: Attack enemies in the area nearby by exploding the gunpowder you have. Using this technique will also damage you and might cause incapability of combat if your HP is too low.

attributes.name: Mijin no Jutsu: Enhance

attributes.name: Mijin no Jutsu: Stealth
attributes.effect: Your character will hide for 5 seconds after using [Mijin no Jutsu]. Increases the duration from Lv2 by 1.5 seconds per attribute level.

11202.name: Bunshin no Jutsu
11202.description: Creates clones of yourself. The clones will act along as a main body and skills can be used along with your clones. The HP of your clones is determined by your DEX.

attributes.name: Bunshin no Jutsu: Endurance
attributes.effect: Increases the Stamina reduction cycle of [Bunshin no Jutsu] by 0.05 seconds per attribute level.

attributes.name: Bunshin no Jutsu: Decreased Damage
attributes.effect: Decreases damage taken by 4% per attribute level when there are at least 2 clones from [Bunshin no Jutsu].

11203.name: Mokuton no Jutsu
11203.description: Counter-attack by tricking the enemy with a fake doll created from a log.

attributes.name: Mokuton no Jutsu: Bind
attributes.effect: Restricts movement of an enemy for 4 seconds when dealing damage with [Mokuton no Jutsu]. Increases the duration from Lv2 by 1 second per attribute level.

11204.name: Katon no Jutsu
11204.description: Attack multiple enemies by continuously exploding the gunpowder you possess.

attributes.name: Katon no Jutsu: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Katon no Jutsu] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Katon no Jutsu: Stealth

11205.name: Kunai

attributes.name: Kunai: Enhance

11401.name: Dragontooth
11401.description: Rotate your spear using centrifugal force to attack an enemy.

attributes.name: Dragontooth: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Dragontooth] by 1% per attribute level.

11402.name: Serpentine
11402.description: Use your spear to deal continuous damage to enemies in front of you.

attributes.name: Serpentine: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Serpentine] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Serpentine: Bleeding
attributes.effect: Enemies hit by [Serpentine] have a 2% chance per attribute level to become afflicted with [Bleeding] for 8 seconds. Bleeding damage is proportional to the character's physical attack.

11403.name: Gae Bulg
11403.description: Attack several enemies within a radius by throwing a spear. Damaged enemies will temporarily become weaker to physical property attacks. The thrown spear must be picked up to use it again.

attributes.name: Gae Bulg: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Gae Bulg] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Gae Bulg: Defense Zone
attributes.effect: Creates a defense zone for 15 seconds where the spear is thrown. Increases physical defense and magic defense by 2% for party members within the zone.

attributes.name: Gae Bulg: Attack Zone
attributes.effect: Creates an attack zone for 15 seconds where the spear is thrown. Increases physical attack and magic attack by 2% for party members within the zone.

11404.name: Dragon Soar
11404.description: Vault into the air while swinging your spear upwards. Enemies hit with this skill are temporarily launched into the air.

attributes.name: Dragon Soar: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Dragon Soar] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Dragon Soar: Shock
attributes.effect: Enemies hit by [Dragon Soar] have a 5% chance per attribute level to be afflicted with [Shock] for 10 seconds.

11501.name: Summon Guild Member
11501.description: Summons a specific guild member to your location. You need permission from the specific guild member.

11502.name: Warp To Guild Member
11502.description: Warps to a specific guild member's location. You cannot warp to guild members who are in an instanced dungeon.

11504.name: Reduce Craft Time
11504.description: Plant a flag that reduces the crafting time of all guild members in the area nearby. This can only be used nearby a Guild Tower.

11505.name: Battle Orders
11505.description: Temporarily increases STR of guild members nearby the guild master. This effect disappears if the guild master is too far away.

20001.name: Energy Bolt

20003.name: Sleep
20003.description: Makes an enemy fall asleep. The enemy awakens once you've reached your limit of attacks.

20004.name: Reflect Shield
20004.description: Creates a protective shield that reflects the amplified damage back to an enemy.

attributes.name: Reflect Shield: Reflect Damage
attributes.effect: Increases reflect damage of [Reflect Shield] by 1 per attribute level and decreases damage received accordingly.

20005.name: Earthquake
20005.description: Inflicts damage on an enemy by creating a powerful earthquake in front of you.

attributes.name: Earthquake: Enhance

20006.name: Surespell

20007.name: Magic Missile
20007.description: Attack continuously with magic bullets. New bullets are shot if it successfully targets an enemy.

attributes.name: Magic Missile: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Magic Missile] by 1% per attribute level.

20008.name: Quick Cast
20008.description: Reduces the casting time of skills.

attributes.name: Quick Cast: Magic Damage

20101.name: Fireball
20101.description: Summons a fireball. Enemies touching the fireball will receive continuous flame damage.

attributes.name: Fireball: Burn Debuff
attributes.effect: Enemies hit by [Fireball] have a 10% chance per attribute level to receive flame damage  for 5 seconds. Flame damage is based on the character's INT.

attributes.name: Fireball: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Fireball] by 1% per attribute level.

20102.name: Fire Wall
20102.description: Creates a wall of flames that continuously damages approaching enemies.

attributes.name: Fire Wall: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Fire Wall] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Fire Wall: Increased Fire Property Buff
attributes.effect: Increases the Fire property attack of an ally by 5 per attribute level for 5 seconds when they step on [Fire Wall].

20103.name: Enchant Fire
20103.description: Temporarily grants the Fire property to you and your party member's attacks.

attributes.name: Enchant Fire: Decreased Fire Property Resistance
attributes.effect: Decreases the Fire property resistance of nearby enemies by 10 per attribute level for 5 seconds when [Enchant Fire] is used.

20104.name: Flare
20104.description: Inflicts damage by exploding a burning enemy.

attributes.name: Flare: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Flare] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Flare: Additional Damage
attributes.effect: Increases the damage of [Flare] by 10 per attribute level to Cloth armor-type enemies.

20105.name: Fire Pillar
20105.description: Summons a pillar of fire to inflict damage on enemies.

attributes.name: Fire Pillar: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Fire Pillar] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Hell Breath] by 1% per attribute level.

20107.name: Flame Ground

attributes.name: Ice Bolt: Chance of Freeze

20202.name: Ice Pike
20202.description: Make ice spikes sprout out in a line to inflict damage. Has a chance of freezing enemies.

attributes.name: Ice Pike: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Ice Spike] by 1% per attribute level.

20203.name: Ice Wall
20203.description: Creates a wall of ice that confines an enemy with a chance of freezing nearby enemies.

attributes.name: Ice Wall: Cryorite
attributes.effect: Cryorite can be dropped with a chance of 1% per attribute level when [Ice Wall] disappears.

20204.name: Ice Blast
20204.description: Inflicts damage on a frozen enemy in front of you. There is a small chance to remove freeze from the enemy when it takes damage.

attributes.name: Ice Blast: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Ice Blast] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Ice Blast: Additional Damage
attributes.effect: Increases the damage of [Ice Blast] by 10 per attribute level when attacking Leather armor-type enemies.

20205.name: Subzero Shield
20205.description: Create a curtain of ice for defense. Inflicts damage after blocking enemy attacks and has a chance of freezing enemies.

attributes.name: Subzero Shield: Counterattack Enhance
attributes.effect: While equipped with a shield when [Subzero Shield] is active, there is an increase in counter attack damage based on your shield's defense. Counter attack damage is enhanced by 50% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Subzero Shield: Duration
attributes.effect: Increases the freeze duration of [Subzero Shield] by 0.5 seconds per attribute level.

20206.name: Gust
20206.description: Creates a strong gust of wind that pushes enemies. When inflicting damage on a frozen enemy, it will unfreeze.

attributes.name: Gust: Collision Damage
attributes.effect: [Gust] deals damage even to unfrozen enemies. Attacks unfrozen enemies 2 times and attacks frozen enemies 3 times.

20207.name: Snow Rolling

attributes.name: Snow Rolling: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Snow Rolling] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Psychic Pressure: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Psychic Pressure] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Psychic Pressure: Stun

Use psychokinesis to capture a target in front and throw it around.

attributes.name: Telekinesis: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Telekinesis] by 1% per attribute level.

20303.name: Swap

20305.name: Magnetic Force

attributes.name: Magnetic Force: Enhance

attributes.name: Magnetic Force: Stun

attributes.name: Raise: Large Monsters

20307.name: Gravity Pole
20307.description: Creates a gravity field in front of you in a line that pulls nearby enemies into it.

attributes.name: Gravity Pole: Evasion

attributes.name: Joint Penalty: Poison

20404.name: Hangman's Knot

20405.name: Spiritual Chain
20405.description: Link party members to share buff effects with each other.

20501.name: Swell Left Arm
20501.description: Enlarge the size of you and your party member's hand to increase attack.

attributes.requirement: Lv. 3 of Swell Left Arm: Enhance required

20506.name: Swell Right Arm

attributes.effect: Increases the defense and attack increase effect of [Swell Right Arm] by 3 per attribute level.

attributes.name: Swell Arm Enhance: Swiftness

20507.name: Swell Brain

attributes.name: Swell Brain: Enhance

attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Hail] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Meteor: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Meteor] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Meteor: Evasion

20607.name: Freezing Sphere

attributes.name: Freezing Sphere: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Freezing Sphere] by 1% per attribute level.

20608.name: Frost Cloud

attributes.name: Frost Cloud: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Frost Cloud] by 1% per attribute level.

20702.name: Attack Ground
20702.description: Order the summoned devil from the Grimoire to move and attack in a targeted area.

attributes.name: Attack Ground: Decreased Cooldown
attributes.effect: Decreases the cooldown of [Attack Ground] by 2 seconds.

20703.name: Riding

20705.name: Hold

attributes.name: Hold: Decreased Cooldown
attributes.effect: Decreases the cooldown of [Hold] by 2 seconds.

attributes.name: Summon Familar: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Summon Familiar] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Summon Salamion: Blind

20708.name: Summon Servant

attributes.name: Summon Servant: Quick Order

20709.name: Evocation
20709.description: Attack enemies with a summoned devil based on the secondary card equipped in the Grimoire.

attributes.name: Evocation: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Evocation] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Desmodus: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Desmodus] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.effect: Increases the critical rate effect from [Quicken] by 5% and decreases evasion by 2% per attribute level.

attributes.effect: When an enemy affected by [Reincarnate] dies and is revived, two enemies will appear with a chance of 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Stop: Decreased SP
attributes.effect: Decreases the SP cost of [Stop] by 40.

attributes.effect: Enemies affected by [Slow] have their critical resistance decreased by a value equal to 15% of the caster's INT.

attributes.name: Slow: Decreased Nullification
attributes.effect: Decreases the chance of nullifying an attack by 6% per attribute level when enemies are affected by [Slow].

20805.name: Haste
20805.description: Temporarily increases the movement speed of you and your party members by manipulating time.

attributes.name: Haste: Increased Evasion
attributes.effect: Increases your evasion by 20 per attribute level while [Haste] is active.

20806.name: Backmasking
20806.description: Control time in an area, temporarily changing it back to its previous state.

attributes.effect: Enemies provoked after using [Backmasking] will be afflicted with [Confusion] for 6 seconds. If the attribute is Lv2, 8 seconds of [Confusion] will be applied.

attributes.name: Gather Corpse: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Gather Corpse] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.effect: Enemies near the Shoggoth will be afflicted with [Decay] for 15 seconds. Lasts for 1 minute per attribute level after Shoggoth is summoned.

attributes.name: Create Shoggoth: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the attack of the summoned Shoggoth by 1 per attribute level.

attributes.name: Conviction: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Conviction] by 1% per attribute level.

40701.name: Iron Skin
40701.description: Temper your skin as hard as steel to inflict damage by bouncing back an enemy's attack.

attributes.name: Iron Skin: Additional Reflect Damage
attributes.effect: Increases the reflection of [Iron Skin] by 5% per attribute level.

40702.name: Double Punch
40702.description: Use your trained fists to attack an enemy in quick succession.

attributes.name: Double Punch: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Double Punch] by 1% per attribute level.

40703.name: Palm Strike
40703.description: Use your trained fingertips to attack an enemy by inflicting an internal injury.

attributes.name: Palm Strike: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Palm Strike] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Palm Strike: Bleeding
attributes.effect: Enemies hit by [Palm Strike] will be afflicted with [Bleeding] for 8 seconds. Increases the duration of [Bleeding] by 1 second per attribute level. Bleeding damage is proportional to the character's physical attack.

40704.name: Hand Knife
40704.description: Strike with a powerful hand knife to deal damage on an enemy.

attributes.name: Hand Knife: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Hand Knife] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Hand Knife: Armor Break
attributes.effect: Enemies hit by [Hand Knife] have a 40% chance to be afflicted with [Armor Break] for 7 seconds. Increases the chance by 10% per attribute level from Lv2.

40705.name: One Inch Punch
40705.description: Extend your fist from a close distance to destroy the insides of an enemy. The attacked enemy will steadily lose HP and SP.

attributes.name: One Inch Punch: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Inch Punch] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: One Inch Punch: Silence
attributes.effect: Enemies hit by [One Inch Punch] will be afflicted with [Silence] for 5 seconds.

40706.name: Energy Blast
40706.description: Harness energy and release it in front of you, dealing damage and pushing back all enemies in its path.

attributes.name: Energy Blast: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Energy Blast] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Energy Blast: Remove Knockdown
attributes.effect: You can change directions while using [Energy Blast]. (You will not be knocked down if this attribute is ON.)

40707.name: God Finger Flick
40707.description: Throw a coin by using the tip of your finger to inflict damage on an enemy.

attributes.name: God Finger Flick: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Finger Flicking] by 1% per attribute level.

40708.name: Golden Bell Shield
40708.description: Change to a state where you become temporarily invincible from all attacks.

attributes.name: Golden Bell Shield: Safety Zone
attributes.effect: The area around the caster will be a safety zone when using [Golden Bell Shield].

40801.name: Simony
40801.description: Craft your skill into a scroll that anyone can use.

40802.name: Indulgentia
40802.description: Use a ritual to cure allies with a Lv2 status ailment or to inflict damage on enemies.

attributes.name: Indulgentia: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Indulgentia] by 1% per attribute level.

40803.name: Discerning Evil
40803.description: Extend the duration of harmful effects applied to an enemy.

attributes.name: Discerning Evil: Increased Targets
attributes.effect: Adds 1 target per attribute level to the applied effects of [Discerning Evil].

40804.name: Oblation
40804.description: Open an offering box to receive donations in the form of items from allies. Can only be opened nearby a Goddess Statue. Cannot be opened in town.

attributes.name: Oblation: Indulgentia Speciality
attributes.effect: Increases the attack of Indulgentia based on the number of items in the Offering Box.

40805.name: Spell Shop
40805.description: Open a shop to sell your skills with beneficial effects.

attributes.name: Spell Shop: Duration
attributes.effect: Increases the duration of [Spell Shop] by 5 minutes per attribute level when you endow a registered effect to your ally.

40808.name: Increase Magic Defense
40808.description: Temporarily increases the magic defense of you and your party members.

attributes.name: Increase Magic Defense: Duration
attributes.effect: Increases the duration of [Increase Magic Defense] by 1 second per attribute level.

40809.name: Decatose
40809.description: Attack an enemy by collecting money to offer to the gods. Enemies, with the exception of boss monsters, can be instantly killed at a 10% chance and the offered money can be picked back up again.

40901.name: Telepath
40901.description: Penetrate into the mind of an enemy in front of you to control it.

40902.name: Carnivory
40902.description: Grass near the targeted area attacks an enemy. It casts in the place of [Chortasmata] first if it exists, otherwise it casts on you.

attributes.name: Carnivory: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Carnivory] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Carnivory: Duration Time
attributes.effect: Increases the duration time of [Carnivory] by 1 second per attribute level.

40903.name: Shape Shifting
40903.description: Transform into a monster of the Animal-type, Plant-type or Insect-type in front of you for a given duration.

40904.name: Transform
40904.description: Transform back into the monster that you last shape shifted to.

40905.name: Sterea Trofh
40905.description: Grown grass protects you and your allies. It casts in the place of [Chortasmata] first if exists, otherwise it casts on you.

40906.name: Chortasmata
40906.description: Grass temporarily grows on the targeted area. Monsters within the targeted area become Plant-type monsters.

attributes.name: Chortasmata: Duration
attributes.effect: Increases the duration of [Chortasmata] by 1 second per attribute level.

41002.name: Arcane Energy
41002.description: Increases the maximum SP and STA of you and your party members.

attributes.name: Arcane Energy: Additional Damage
attributes.effect: Enemies receive holy damage equal to [attribute level] within the range of [Arcane Energy].

attributes.name: Arcane Energy: Duration
attributes.effect: Increases the duration of [Arcane Energy] by 1 minute per attribute level.

41003.name: Change
41003.description: Changes the monster in front of you to a different monster with a similar level.

attributes.name: Change: Winning
attributes.effect: A monster that is transformed by [Change] will have the Item Jackpot Effect with a 0.05% chance per attribute level.

41004.name: Clairvoyance
41004.description: Predict and show which item the monster will drop in advance.

41006.name: Forecast
41006.description: Show in advance where the enemy will attack you and your party members.

attributes.name: Forecast: Duration
attributes.effect: Increases the duration of [Forecast] by 2 seconds per attribute level.

attributes.name: Forecast: Increased Nullification
attributes.effect: Increases the chance to nullify an enemy's attack while activating [Forecast] by 1% per attribute level.

41007.name: Resetting
41007.description: Change the item dropped from an enemy to a different item. You will be notified when an item is changed.

attributes.name: Resetting: Decreased Cooldown
attributes.effect: Decreases the cooldown of [Resetting] by 30 seconds.

41008.name: Death Sentence
41008.description: Sentence the enemy to death. The sentenced target dies when time is up.

attributes.name: Death Sentence: Slow
attributes.effect: Decreases the movement speed of an enemy affected by [Death Sentence] by 15% per attribute level.

41009.name: Prophecy
41009.description: Grants a temporary effect preventing Lv. 1 status ailments to nearby party members.

41101.name: Healing Factor
41101.description: Temporarily creates a magic circle that grants a healing factor. HP will be quickly recovered if you or your allies take damage from an enemy inside the magic circle.

41102.name: Incineration
41102.description: Incinerate enemies with status ailments. The duration of [Incineration] will increase depending on the amount of status ailments on enemies.

attributes.name: Incineration: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Incineration] by 1% per attribute level.

41103.name: Bloodletting
41103.description: Temporarily let you or your allies bleed to prevent further status ailments. This state will be invulnerable to all rank 2 or lower status ailments.

attributes.name: Bloodletting: Hemostasis
attributes.effect: Increases the cycle time of the HP cost by 0.02 seconds per attribute level while [Bloodletting] is in effect.

attributes.name: Bloodletting: Substitute SP
attributes.effect: Each tick has a 10% chance per attribute level to reduce SP instead of HP while [Bloodletting] is in effect.

41104.name: Fumigate
41104.description: Spray a cloud of antidote that cures the status ailments of an ally. Allies within the effect will be cured of rank 3 or lower status ailments.

attributes.name: Fumigate: Prevention
attributes.effect: Increases the chance that [Fumigate] blocks Lv3 or weaker status ailments for 10 seconds by 5% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Fumigate: Purification
attributes.effect: The range of [Fumigate] becomes a purification area for 10 seconds. Increases the ally's poison resistance by 10% per attribute level.

41105.name: Pandemic
41105.description: Spread all status ailments on targeted enemies to other enemies within the range.

41106.name: Beak Mask
41106.description: Equip the Bird Beak Mask. The front side of the mask has a special drug that prevents rank 2 or lower status ailments from affecting you.

attributes.name: Bird Beak Mask: Poison Resistance
attributes.effect: Increases Poison property resistance by 5 per attribute level whilst wearing the [Bird Beak Mask].

41201.name: Revenged Sevenfold
41201.description: Use the power of the goddess to avenge yourself with x7 the power of an enemy's attack.

attributes.name: Revenged Sevenfold: Duration
attributes.effect: Increases the duration of [Revenged Sevenfold]'s effect by 1 second per attribute level.

attributes.name: Revenged Sevenfold: Curse
attributes.effect: Inflicts [Curse] at a 10% chance for 4 seconds on an enemy when damage is dealt with [Revenged Sevenfold].

41203.name: Ein Sof
41203.description: Creates a magic circle that drastically increases your maximum HP for a period of time.

attributes.name: Ein Sof: SP Recovery
attributes.effect: Exchanges half the maximum HP recovery of [Ein Sof] for SP recovery instead.

attributes.name: Ein Sof: Maintain Time
attributes.effect: Increases the duration of [Ein Sof] tiles by 1 second per attribute level.

41204.name: Merkabah
41204.description: Summons the wagon of the goddess to attack enemies.

attributes.name: Merkabah: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Merkabah] by 1% per attribute level.

attributes.name: Merkabah: Petrification
attributes.effect: Inflicts [Petrification] for 3 seconds on enemies affected by [Curse] when attacking with [Merkabah].

41205.name: Gematria
41205.description: Divide the numbers of an enemy's name and calculate a new number.

41206.name: Notarikon
41206.description: Calculate a new number from the first and the last letter of an enemy's name.

41208.name: Reduce Level
41208.description: Decrease the level of an enemy depending on the calculated number.

41301.name: Last Rites
41301.description: Makes the attacks of party members have the Holy property. Increases Holy property damage in proportion to the caster's [Sacrament] level which becomes more powerful when HP is below 40%.

attributes.name: Last Rites: Promoting Spirits
attributes.effect: Increases the lower limit HP of [Last Rites] by 2% per attribute level.

41302.name: Deploy Capella
41302.description: Deploys a temporary sacellum with a wrapped cloak. The caster and party members are able to simultaneously receive the effects of the caster's Aspersion, Monstrance, Blessing, Sacrament, Stone Skin.

attributes.name: Deploy Cappella: Duration
attributes.effect: Increases the duration of the deployed capella of [Deploy Cappella] by 3 seconds.

41303.name: Magnus Exorcismus
41303.description: Transforms the Exorcise Magic Circle in front of the caster into an enormous pillar of exorcism. This divine pillar of light continues to damage nearby enemies.

attributes.name: Magnus Exorcismus: Enhance
attributes.effect: Increases the damage dealt on an enemy with [Magnus Exorcismus] by 1% per attribute level.

41304.name: Aspergillum
41304.description: Fills the equipped weapon with holy water and makes it splash with every attack. The level of holy water being used is the same level as the caster's [Aspersion].
